description: Orders the AI summary of a tender's documentation (SWZ) — the same as 'Wygeneruj teraz' in Przetargowy Janusz: queues the summary, or first the download or reading of the tender documents. By tender_id or public slug. status: already-done (the summary is there — read it with get_tender or get_my_tender), generating (ready in a few minutes), fetch-needed (documents are being downloaded — ask again in a few minutes), extraction-needed (no SWZ among the documents), no-source / no-documents (nothing to summarize), error. Requires OAuth authentication and a trial or paid plan.

slug.description: public slug, when there is no tender_id
